rationale: Higher-order morphology. coccus and ovoid are kept separate because ovoid carries real information -- Shape_ovoid is largely Acinetobacter, which are coccobacilli, not cocci -- so collapsing them would misclassify more species than it fixes. But in metagenomic applications the spherical/slightly-ovoid distinction is rarely the biological question, and BacDive's annotation is inconsistent for some species (Veillonella parvula is recorded oval-shaped though the literature calls it coccal). This union gives the broader category without destroying the source distinction.
